greek: καὶ ἐπλήρωσαν αὐτοῦ τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας· οὕτως γὰρ καταριθμοῦνται αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς ταφῆς. καὶ ἐπένθησεν αὐτὸν Αἴγυπτος ἑβδομήκοντα ἡμέρας.
hint: Forty days are given to the burial rites, and Egypt mourns Jacob for seventy.

notes.text: The days of the burial: the Hebrew counts yĕmê haḥănuṭîm, the days of the embalming.
They fulfilled his forty days, the genitive of the one the days are for.
The land as subject: Egypt mourned him. The Hebrew has miṣrayim, Egypt, likewise.

greek: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ιωσηφ εἰς Αἴγυπτον, αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ συναναβάντες θάψαι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ.
hint: Joseph returns to Egypt with his brothers and all who went up to the burial.

notes.text: ἀποστρέφω, to turn back, used without object: he returned.

hint: With their father dead, the brothers fear that Joseph will now repay them for the wrong they did him.

notes.text: Perfect of θνήσκω, which Middle Liddell gives in the perfect as to be dead: the state, not the event.
μήποτε with the aorist subjunctive, a fear: lest Joseph remember the wrongs. The Hebrew has lû yiśṭĕmēnû, if Joseph should hate us.
Noun and verb from one root, for the Hebrew infinitive absolute hāšēb yāšîb.
Aorist middle of ἐνδείκνυμι: the middle's senses, and to inform against, which Middle Liddell gives so in Mid.

greek: καὶ παρεγένοντο πρὸς Ιωσηφ λέγοντες Ὁ πατήρ σου ὥρκισεν πρὸ τοῦ τελευτῆσαι αὐτὸν λέγων
hint: The brothers come to Joseph, saying their father put them under oath before he died.

notes.text: They came to Joseph: the Hebrew has wayṣawwû, they sent a command to Joseph.
He made swear, with no object: the Hebrew has ṣiwwâ, he commanded.
πρό with the articular infinitive and its subject in the accusative: before his ending.

reading: and [[were beside|were beside / were by / near / attended upon, were present at, came to their side / came to aid / stood by / seconded / supported, were at hand / were gained / accrued, came to, arrived / came up, came to maturity, were fully grown|παραγίνομαι]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Ιωσηφ]] [[saying|saying / speaking, saying / declaring, saying something of, calling by name, telling, boasting of / telling of, reciting|λέγω]] [[the father|the father, the grandfather|πατήρ]] of you [[made swear|made swear|ὁρκίζω]] [[before|before, before / in front of, in defence of / for, further on, before / sooner / rather than, above, for|πρό]] [[of the completing|of the completing / finishing / accomplishing, of the fulfilling an oath / promise, of the bringing about, of the bringing to an end, of the ending life / dying, of the making an end of, of the coming to an end, of the ending / issuing in|τελευτάω]] him [[saying|saying / speaking, saying / declaring, saying something of, calling by name, telling, boasting of / telling of, reciting|λέγω]]

greek: Οὕτως εἴπατε Ιωσηφ Ἄφες αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀδικίαν καὶ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν, ὅτι πονηρά σοι ἐνεδείξαντο· καὶ νῦν δέξαι τὴν ἀδικίαν τῶν θεραπόντων τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ πατρός σου. καὶ ἔκλαυσεν Ιωσηφ λαλούντων αὐτῶν πρὸς αὐτόν.
hint: The message asks Joseph to forgive the brothers, servants of his father's God; Joseph weeps as they speak.

notes.text: ἀφίημι, to send away, let go: of a wrong, to let it go.

hint: The brothers come and offer themselves to Joseph as his household slaves.

notes.text: Having come to him: the Hebrew adds wayyippĕlû lĕpānāyw, they fell before him.

hint: Joseph tells them not to fear, for he belongs to God; the Hebrew asks whether he stands in God's place.

hint: Joseph promises to provide for them and their households, and comforts them.

notes.text: Your households: the Hebrew has ṭappĕkem, your little ones.

hint: Joseph stays in Egypt with his brothers and his father's household, and lives a hundred and ten years.

notes.text: He and his brothers: the Hebrew has hûʾ ûbêt ʾābîw, he and his father's house, without the brothers.

greek: καὶ εἶδεν Ιωσηφ Εφραιμ παιδία ἕως τρίτης γενεᾶς, καὶ υἱοὶ Μαχιρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Μανασση ἐτέχθησαν ἐπὶ μηρῶν Ιωσηφ.
hint: Joseph sees Ephraim's line to the third generation, and Machir's sons are born upon his thighs.

notes.text: Upon Joseph's thighs: the Hebrew has ʿal-birkê yôsēp̄, upon Joseph's knees.
Εφραιμ read as genitive: Ephraim's children, to the third generation, for the Hebrew bĕnê šillēšîm.

(Μαχιρ, from Hebrew Mākîr, usually connected with mākar, "to sell")
(Μανασση, from Hebrew Mĕnaššeh, which the Hebrew hears in naššanî, "he made me forget")

greek: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσηφ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ λέγων Ἐγὼ ἀποθνῄσκω· ἐπισκοπῇ δὲ ἐπισκέψεται ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἀνάξει ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ταύτης εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἣν ὤμοσεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ.
hint: Dying, Joseph tells his brothers that God will visit them and bring them up to the land sworn to their fathers.

notes.text: The dative of the noun with its own verb, for the Hebrew infinitive absolute pāqōd yip̄qōd: God will look upon you with a looking-upon.
Middle Liddell gives a watching over, visitation, then the office of ἐπίσκοπος, from the New Testament, where the word is the overseer's office.

notes.text: God swore to our fathers: the Hebrew has nišbaʿ, he swore, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, without God named and without our fathers.

greek: καὶ ὥρκισεν Ιωσηφ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ λέγων Ἐν τῇ ἐπισκοπῇ, ᾗ ἐπισκέψεται ὑμᾶς ὁ θεός, καὶ συνανοίσετε τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐντεῦθεν μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
hint: Joseph has the sons of Israel swear to carry his bones up with them when God visits them.

notes.text: With you: not in the Hebrew of this verse, which has only mizzeh, from here. The Hebrew of Exodus 13:19, recalling the oath, has ʾittĕkem, with you.
Future of συναναφέρω, to carry up together: not in Middle Liddell, and LSJ's active senses stand here.
καί opening the main clause after the clause of time, as the Hebrew wĕ-.

reading: and [[made swear|made swear|ὁρκίζω]] [[name:Ιωσηφ]] the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[saying|saying / speaking, saying / declaring, saying something of, calling by name, telling, boasting of / telling of, reciting|λέγω]] [[in the watching over|within, inside of, and by means of the watching over / visitation, the office of episkopos (ἐπίσκοπος), the office|ἐν; ἐπισκοπή]], to which [[will look upon|will look upon / look at / inspect / observe / examine / regard, will watch over, will visit, will inspect / review, will consider / reflect, will examine with himself / meditate|ἐπισκέπτομαι]] you [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]], and [[you will carry up together|you will carry up together, you will bring up together with yourselves, you will refer to at the same time, you will certify at the same time, you will report|συναναφέρω]] [[the bones|the bones, the bones of the dead|ὀστέον]] of me [[hence|hence / thence, henceforth / thenceforth / thereupon, from that source|ἐντεῦθεν]] [[in the midst of|in the midst of, among, in common, along with, with, by means of|μετά + genitive]] of you.

greek: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Ιωσηφ ἐτῶν ἑκατὸν δέκα· καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔθηκαν ἐν τῇ σορῷ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ.
hint: Joseph dies at a hundred and ten, and is buried and laid in a coffin in Egypt.

notes.text: They buried him: the Hebrew has wayyaḥanṭû ʾōtô, they embalmed him.
σορός, a vessel for holding, a cinerary urn, a coffin, for the Hebrew ʾărôn, a chest.
τελευτάω, to complete, to finish, and of life, to end it and die.

reading: and [[completed|completed / finished / accomplished, fulfilled an oath / promise, brought about, brought to an end, ended life / died, made an end of, came to an end, ended / issued in|τελευτάω]] [[name:Ιωσηφ]] of years of a hundred of ten; and [[paid the last dues to a corpse|paid the last dues to a corpse / honoured with funeral rites, buried / interred|θάπτω]] him and [[set|set / put / placed, planted, laid, deposited, deposited a claim for, paid down / paid, placed to account / put down / reckoned, laid in the grave / buried, set up, devoted / dedicated, assigned / awarded, laid down / give, alleged, established / instituted, ordained / commanded, put in a certain state / made, laid down / assumed / held / reckoned / regarded as, counted, made / worked / executed, made / caused / brought to pass, settled / arranged, managed|τίθημι]] [[in the vessel for holding|within, inside of, and by means of the vessel for holding, the cinerary urn, the coffin|ἐν; σορός]] [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to [[name:Αἰγύπτῳ]].
